keyVerseDR: "Well done, good and faithful servant... Enter thou into the joy of thy lord." (Mt 25:21)

level1.title: Use Your Gifts
level1.story: A master gave his servants talents of money. Two servants used them well. The third hid his in the ground. God wants us to use our gifts!
level1.keyLine: I use my gifts for God.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the good servants do?
level1.prayer: God, thank You for my gifts. Amen.

activity.title: My gift badge
activity.intro: God gave you gifts! Design a badge for one of your talents.
activity.label: I use my gifts for God

level2.title: The Parable of the Talents
level2.story: Jesus told of a man going on a journey who gave his servants talents: five to one, two to another, and one to a third. The first two traded and doubled what they had. The third dug a hole and hid his master's money. When the master returned, he said to the faithful servants, "Well done, good and faithful servant; enter into the joy of thy lord." But the servant who buried his talent lost even what he had.
level2.keyLine: Well done, good and faithful servant.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did the third servant bury his talent?
What talent can you use for God?
actions: Use a talent at church or home
level2.prayer: Lord, help me use my gifts for You. Amen.
